summary: ASE Technology Holding, a Taiwan-based semiconductor packaging and testing company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 30, 2026, containing its second-quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing reports consolidated revenues grew 24% year-over-year in 1H2026, with ATM revenues up 35%, and provides an outlook including expected ATM revenue growth of 35% for the full year. The document includes safe harbor language, market dynamics, and strategic priorities. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No M&A, restructuring, or other special category applies; it is an ordinary quarterly financial update with forward-looking statements.
